gloss: transfer to a different facility; relocation

definitions.gloss: transfer to a different facility; relocation of placement
definitions.explanation: The act of transferring a person from one facility, institution, or care center to another. Commonly used in welfare, medical, and institutional contexts for transfers between care homes, hospitals, or detention facilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転所|てんしょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{患者|かんじゃ}→患者：00170_kanja⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{回復期|かいふくき}⟦リハビリ→リハビリ：11192_rihabiri⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転所|てんしょ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The patient was transferred to a rehabilitation hospital.

examples.japanese: ⟦{介護|かいご}{施設|しせつ}→介護施設：28076_kaigoshisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{定員|ていいん}→定員：04532_teiin⟧⟦オーバー→オーバー：01529_oobaa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{一部|いちぶ}→一部：06783_ichibu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入所者|にゅうしょしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近隣|きんりん}→近隣：14361_kinrin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転所|てんしょ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: Due to the care facility being over capacity, some residents will be transferred to nearby facilities.

notes:
A compound of {転|てん} (transfer/change) and ⟦{所|しょ}→〜所：09844_sho⟧ (place/facility). Used specifically for institutional transfers — when a person is moved from one facility or institution to another.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{施設|しせつ}→施設：02503_shisetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{転所|てんしょ}: facility transfer
- {転所|てんしょ}⟦{手続|てつづ}き→手続き：05453_tetsuzuki⟧: transfer procedures
- {転所|てんしょ}⟦{先|さき}→先：02883_saki⟧: destination facility (after transfer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {転院|てんいん}: hospital transfer (specifically between hospitals)
- ⟦{転居|てんきょ}→転居：15236_tenkyo⟧: change of residence; moving house (general relocation)
- ⟦{異動|いどう}→異動：01818_idou⟧: personnel transfer (within an organization, for employees)
- ⟦{入所|にゅうしょ}→入所：12025_nyuusho⟧: admission to a facility (entering a care home, institution, etc.)
